snippet.title: Outer Wilds - The Vision trailer (unofficial story mod)
snippet.description:
I'm happy to announce my first mod ever for my favorite game - Outer Wilds. 

DOWNLOAD LINK: 
https://outerwildsmods.com/mods/thevision/

This mod continues the main Outer Wilds story and the Echoes of the Eye DLC. You will need to finish both for this mod.

Music from this video:
Andrew Prahlow (https://youtu.be/JAfRDEaZP4E)
The Mastering Factory (https://youtu.be/-kk2XyJmwqY?t=505),  
J Solo (https://youtu.be/TpFJCAKiY6U?t=438)

Mods used for this trailer:
NomaiVR (VR mod) - https://outerwildsmods.com/mods/nomaivr/
New Horizons - https://outerwildsmods.com/mods/newhorizons/
No HUD mod - https://www.reddit.com/r/outerwilds/comments/qiubmu/i_patched_the_no_hud_mod_to_work_with_the_dlc/

Join our Outer Wilds Modding Discord server: https://discord.gg/9vE5aHxcF9

All rights belongs to Mobius Digital.

#outerwilds , #echoesoftheeye , #mobiusdigital
